answer: An operator running 58 keys therefore pays for 58 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the canyon quota and the ocean admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 7 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. Since the throttle counters live in the haven ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
